verdict.rationale: Veo 3's own docs say it can generate dialogue natively alongside the video. A hands-on community report praises how well the audio and video match up and calls the dialogue on par with dedicated voice models. However, no first-party documentation explicitly describes lip movement synced to speech, or how a creator's exact script is rendered as spoken lines. Missing for 10: explicit documented lip-sync capability, documentation of delivering user-scripted dialogue verbatim, independent evidence specifically about mouth-movement accuracy.

support.subject: As a creator, generated characters speak my dialogue with lip movement matched to the audio

citations.quote: Veo 3 lets you add sound effects, ambient noise, and even dialogue to your creations – generating all audio natively.
Blown away at how well the audio/video matches up, and the dialogue is better sounding / on-par with dedicated voice models.
the audio integration really makes a huge difference, especially given it does both sounds and voices.
